core_categories: Urological/Catheters; Ostomy Supplies; Incontinence Products; Mastectomy Supplies; Diabetes Supplies
specialty_focus: Liberator Medical Supply is a direct-to-consumer distributor of home medical supplies, specializing in repeat-order chronic disease care and primarily serving seniors. It offers automated reorder reminders, insurance navigation with direct billing to Medicare and private insurance, and trained product specialists. It deals in wearable medical devices such as the PureWick™ System for urinary incontinence.
